title: DESCRIPTION
source:
*EXAMINATION WORKS:*

* Given the Grade X Marksheet certificate to the student.(ID-2042, 1313)
* Formatted  the SANSKRIT question paper for grade 10 for the Dream-Big Exams.
* Printed the Sanskrit question paper for grade X for the HOD's proofing
* Verified the few National School Games Bonafide certificate.(approx-09)
* Uploaded & updated the student's (Birth , Aadhar, & Caste certificate) on the Eduletics portal.(approx-06)
* Updated the Excel sheet with the Grade IX registration data.
* Find the Pre-Mid-Term marksheets as requested in the parents’ application (IDs: 5251, 2860, and 5654).
* Find the Mid-Term examination answer sheets as requested in the parents’ applications.(Id - 2058, 2730)
* Updated the Excel sheet with the Grade IX registration data.

*OTHER WORK:*

* Dispersal Duty.
* Prepared the Biometric attendance record of Teaching, Non-Teaching, Admin, Transport, Guard and 4th grade employee given by Principal Sir.
* Collected homework feedback from the first-floor classes and shared it via a Google Form.
* Collected notebooks from the following classes:
* 5 SIGMA [SCIENCE]
* 6 OMEGA [SST]
* 6 SIGMA [ICT]
* 7 OMICRON [ICT]
* 8 OMICRON [ELA]
* 8 SIGMA [SST]
* 8 ZETA [CHEMISTRY]
